{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
[[File:Leia_photomasher.jpg|thumb|250px|Princess Leia Organa wearing the gown.]]
The '''traditional gown''' of the Alderaan royal family was a garb worn by the [[Gender/Legends|women]] of the royal class on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. As a [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] of Alderaan and a member of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] often wore this classic attire, which consisted of a [[Color/Legends|white]] gown with long flared sleeves, a turtleneck and a hood. The white color itself was the trademark of the Alderaan Royal family.<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> It was usually worn with a [[Alderaan royalty symbolic belt|symbolic belt]] of the planet's royalty.<ref name="SWTVD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Organa kept wearing similar [[Clothing/Legends|garments]] throughout the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]<ref name="Star Search">[[Star Wars (1977) 11|''Star Wars'' (1977) 11]]</ref> and on board the [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>
